Change c0379. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): This letter in a degree recalled me to life, and I determined to quit my island at the expiration of two days.

1818 text: Yet, before I departed, there was a task to perform, on which I shuddered to reflect: I must pack my chemical instruments; and for that purpose I must enter the room which had been the scene of my odious work, and I must handle those utensils, the sight of which was sickening to me. The next morning, at day-break, I summoned sufficient courage, and unlocked the door of my laboratory.

1831 text: Yet, before I departed, there was a task to perform, on which I shuddered to reflect: I must pack up my chemical instruments; and for that purpose I must enter the room which had been the scene of my odious work, and I must handle those utensils, the sight of which was sickening to me. The next morning, at daybreak, I summoned sufficient courage, and unlocked the door of my laboratory.

Diff: Yet, before I departed, there was a task to perform, on which I shuddered to reflect: I must pack {+up+} my chemical instruments; and for that purpose I must enter the room which had been the scene of my odious work, and I must handle those utensils, the sight of which was sickening to me. The next morning, at [-day-break-] {+daybreak+} , I summoned sufficient courage, and unlocked the door of my laboratory.

Context after (unchanged): The remains of the half-finished creature, whom I had destroyed, lay scattered on the floor, and I almost felt as if I had mangled the living flesh of a human being.

result.rationale: Only 'pack up' for 'pack' (phrasal verb addition) and 'daybreak' for 'day-break' (hyphen dropped, compound spelling); no change to meaning or events.
